rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when emotionally begging someone to do or not do something.

example.english: I plead with you, please don't leave now.
example.traditional: 我求吓你，唔好而家走呀。
example.jyutping: ngo5 kau4 haa2 nei5 m4 hou2 ji4 gaa1 zau2 aa3

rows.note: Use this when offering A as an excuse for avoiding something or explaining an action.

example.english: They plead traffic as an excuse whenever they are late.
example.traditional: 佢成日攞塞車做藉口，遲到都唔認。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 lo2 sak1 ce1 zou6 ze6 hau2 ci4 dou3 dou1 m4 jing6

rows.note: Use this in the legal setting when a defendant formally enters a plea or presents a defence.

example.english: In court, the defendant has to plead that they did not do it.
example.traditional: 被告喺庭上答辯，話自己冇做過。
example.jyutping: bei6 gou3 hai2 ting4 soeng6 daap3 bin6 waa6 zi6 gei2 mou5 zou6 gwo3
